2759.text: Our Father who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth, as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us, and lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil.
2759.notes: Only the liturgical text of the Lord's Prayer as given at 2759 is cached here, not the whole paragraph. Used in Ch 10 line 235.
